info.description: Authentication uses Bearer tokens; each operation's security declaration names the accepted schemes, and public operations declare an empty security array. Errors use the `ErrorBody` envelope, and every response includes `x-daytona-trace-id` so support can locate the request. Lists use `limit` and an opaque `cursor`, and return `next_cursor` when another page exists. Some deployments serve API areas at different base URLs; a request sent to a base URL that does not serve it returns 501 (`WORKLOAD_PLANE_ELSEWHERE` or `MANAGEMENT_PLANE_ELSEWHERE`). Sandbox create requests may select a region with the `x-daytona-region` request header; searches filter by region with the `region_ids` query parameter. Adding an enum value is not a breaking change; clients must accept values they don't recognize.
